disclosure: Authored PAY-142 walkthrough for Our Banking Client. Proposed capabilities and sample artifacts; no live bank integration or measured result.

nodes.title: 01 / Understand the change
nodes.before: Copy the story; chase ambiguous retry rules.
nodes.detail: AI drafts questions about a timeout after acceptance. The product owner confirms that the same key and payload return the original transfer.
nodes.artifact: AC-142: retry must preserve the transfer ID and create no second posting.

nodes.title: 02 / Design test cases
nodes.before: Assemble spreadsheet cases and check gaps by hand.
nodes.detail: AI proposes normal, timeout, duplicate callback, concurrent retry and conflicting-payload cases. Domain QA defines expected results independently.
nodes.artifact: CASE-142-R: timeout after acceptance; retry same key; expect one transfer.

nodes.title: 03 / Draft unit tests
nodes.before: Developers handwrite unit tests; QA finds missing behavior later.
nodes.detail: AI drafts a unit test for the idempotency handler. The developer reviews the fake repository and verifies repeated calls do not create a second transfer. This does not prove integration.
nodes.artifact: JUnit: create twice with the same key; verify one repository insertion.

nodes.title: 04 / Build API / UI tests
nodes.before: Handwrite requests, selectors, assertions and helpers.
nodes.detail: AI drafts API tests and selected UI checks. Reviewers reject a status-only assertion and require the original transfer ID, one journal and agreed balances.
nodes.artifact: PR-142: API assertions for transfer ID, journal count and balances; UI pending/retry state.

nodes.title: 05 / Prepare data and stubs
nodes.before: Find usable accounts; book vendor slots; wait for shared resets.
nodes.detail: AI drafts seed scripts and timeout mappings. Engineers validate fixtures and the provider model; containers and CI create repeatable runs. Real-provider checks still need vendor slots.
nodes.artifact: FIX-142: payer 100000, recipient 0 minor units; STUB-142: accept then timeout.

nodes.title: 06 / Select and run tests
nodes.before: Run manual regression packs, collect screenshots and queue reruns.
nodes.detail: AI recommends affected tests or requests an authorized pipeline. Azure Pipelines and test runners execute approved tests. Required payment coverage cannot be silently omitted.
nodes.artifact: RUN-142: immutable build, test, fixture and stub versions; raw assertion results.

nodes.title: 07 / Investigate failures
nodes.before: Compare logs across systems and reconstruct the failure.
nodes.detail: AI groups related failures and proposes duplicate posting as a cause, linking the assertion and journal evidence. A person confirms the diagnosis; AI cannot rewrite the failing verdict.
nodes.artifact: DEF-142: expected 1 journal; observed 2 in the injected-defect example.

nodes.title: 08 / Repair and retest
nodes.before: Coordinate fixes, reset shared data and wait for another test slot.
nodes.detail: AI can propose a repair. The developer reviews the production change; test expectations stay fixed. CI performs a fresh run and challenges the tests with the duplicate-posting variant.
nodes.artifact: RERUN-143: corrected build passes; deliberately faulty variant must still fail.

nodes.title: 09 / Review release evidence
nodes.before: Reconcile screenshots and spreadsheets; chase approvals.
nodes.detail: AI drafts a release summary and suggests reviewed defects for regression. Owners inspect required coverage, real-provider checks and unresolved gaps before deciding.
nodes.artifact: PACK-142: retain the failed run, repaired run, review and remaining release gates.
